_doc: Head-wire route study 2026-10-14 (guide/print/head-wires-20261014). Robot frame mm (x forward, y left, z up), q = 0 unless a pose is given. Model: taut straight spans between route points riding on their MJCF bodies (neck-route/motion.py), exact distances to the current audit solids (interference-audit cache), 1.7 mm group radius for the eight wires lying two deep (inference from V1.9). Negative clearance on a free span (different bodies at its ends) is the taut-line artefact also present in the V1.9 release numbers (route-v19-motion.json); negative clearance on a span whose both ends ride on the head is a real squeeze between the head and another body.

jointRangesDeg.rollSignConvention: MJCF head_roll axis is -x at (8.1, 0, 115.6); positive roll tilts the crown towards +y (robot left)

leftRearTrianglePlusY.sharedWith: ID11-to-ID13 servo cable (ttl-13-11), centreline at (13.8, 12.2, 127.3); its X3P cable is about 3 mm across, so about 3.3 mm of the 6.3 mm is left for the eight wires
leftRearTrianglePlusY.source: neck-route/corridors.json entry-1 (measured), route B in its README

partClearancesAtQ0._doc: q = 0, centreline-to-surface distance minus 1.7 mm, nearest point of the whole route to each named head/neck part (scratch/part_dist_q0.py). Inside/outside comes from the nearest face normal, which fails far from the surface on non-convex parts: designed/hybrid speaker_tape -99.5 and motor13 -53.06, and hybrid neck_pitch -3.0, are such artefacts (the motion model gives motor13 0.28 for the designed route at rest and nothing closer than motor11 0.47 for the hybrid at rest). Use the motion-model partMin for cross-body parts; use this table for the head-fixed parts (speaker, retainer, amplifier, Pi, camera, clips).

rollWindow.method: rollSweep: head roll alone, -25..+25 deg in 2.5 deg steps, yaw/pitch 0, jaw closed; clearance = exact distance from the taut route centreline to the nearest part on another body, minus the 1.7 mm group radius; negative = the group is squeezed

hybrid.description: Torso and bracket clips kept on the -y side; from the bracket clip the group crosses behind the bracket to the left-rear entry. No head clip.

leftrear.description: Shawn's left-rear entry: pack notch, up the rear-left corner of the neck, behind the bracket, +y strip of the floor opening, the triangle between the yaw link, ID15 and the jaw support, over ID15 at y 19, joining the release route at the cap clip approach. No torso, bracket or head clip.
